_about: Trimmed from the S1-4-saturday part of revision 1 of the subway-timetables dataset as stored in skku_content and skku_content_dev on 2026-10-20 (each part hash-equal to its committed file at commit 7718b7c0), 85 of its 390 trains in their order: each train whose time at a served platform falls from 50 minutes before (10 where no tracker tick is pinned) to 90 minutes after a pinned instant of its day type (weekday 08:00 (the tick), 00:20 and 02:00 KST; Saturday 14:00; public holiday 11:00, and 14:00 for the Korail and Shinbundang holiday tables, which serve Saturdays), or from 10 minutes before to 30 minutes after an instant a unit or route test reads the tables at (weekday 18:13 to 18:17, 20:20 to 21:12 and 22:27 KST; Saturday 10:07 to 10:46 and 21:07). The part schema strips this note. Revision 2 (2026-10-25, ADR 0022 D4) widens the table's stations for 사당, 금정 and 종로5가: each train above is its revision-2 row, and the revision-2 trains whose time at one of those platforms falls from 50 minutes before to 90 minutes after a pinned tick of its day type (and the holiday 12:23 of the 2026-10-25 captures) are added, in the part's order.
